title: SU3HOB-ladder: harmonic-oscillator brackets in the SU(3) basis from pseudo-spin ladder operators

creators.name: Stepšys, Augustinas
creators.affiliation: Center for Physical Sciences and Technology (FTMC), Vilnius, Lithuania

creators.name: Germanas, Darius
creators.affiliation: Center for Physical Sciences and Technology (FTMC), Vilnius, Lithuania

description:
A Fortran 2008 package computing the general Talmi–Moshinsky harmonic-oscillator transformation brackets for an arbitrary mass-ratio parameter d in the SU(3) basis.

The SU(3) ⊃ SO(3) isofactors are generated internally from the U(2) pseudo-spin ladder operators of the chain U(6) ⊃ U(3) × U(2): the highest-weight states are the null space of the raising operator, and the remaining members of each multiplet follow by lowering. No SU(3) recoupling machinery, K-matrix or outer-multiplicity resolution is required at any point, and no SU(3) coupling library is needed.

The isofactors are independent of d, so a block is prepared once and evaluated for any number of mass ratios. Validated over every block with E ≤ 50.
